{
  "status": "ADVISORY",
  "observations": [
    "The USCo supplier invoice (INV-SG-001) requires settlement of 250,000 USD to approved Singapore supplier SUP-SG-001, via either USD or USDC.",
    "USCo holds sufficient balances for settlement: 1,250,000 USD in ACC-US-OPER-01 (bank operating) and 300,000 USDC in WAL-US-USDC-01 (institutional wallet).",
    "Both eligible rails—bank_wire_cross_border (USD) and stablecoin_transfer (USDC)—are permitted by policy and authority envelope for this transaction.",
    "No forecasted USD or USDC liquidity shortfalls are present for USCo over the relevant horizon; a surplus is projected.",
    "The supplier, destination, and jurisdiction (SG) are all approved and verified for this payment.",
    "No policy, authority, or segregation of duties conflicts are detected for this obligation.",
    "These are advisory observations only; no action is proposed or executed at this stage."
  ]
}
